# SWEEPR Deepblock v1.3.2 — Zero Ads. Zero Pop-Ups. Browse in Peace.

> SWEEPR Deepblock (https://sweeprdeepblock.com) is a privacy-first, local-first Manifest V3 browser extension for Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox (Desktop & Android), Brave, and Opera. It blocks video & banner ads (283 static declarativeNetRequest rules: 264 ads/trackers, 18 cryptominers, 1 URL tracking parameter rule + 100 dynamic OTA rules + 391 cosmetic selectors), automatically clicks "Reject All" on GDPR cookie pop-ups across major CMP frameworks without breaking page scrolling, strips tracking parameters, includes an interactive Element Zapper, and hibernates idle tabs with Total Tab & RAM Tamer.

## Key Consumer Benefits & Verified Capabilities (v1.3.2)
- **Zero Video & Banner Ads:** Blocks pre-roll and mid-roll video ads on YouTube, Twitch, and streaming sites using native Manifest V3 `declarativeNetRequest` rules (283 static + 100 dynamic OTA rules) + DeepStealth DOM sanitization.
- **Automatic Cookie Pop-Up Rejector + Scroll Unlock:** Automatically executes the genuine "Reject All / Necessary Only" signal on GDPR consent frameworks (OneTrust, Didomi, Usercentrics, Quantcast, Sourcepoint, TrustArc, Cookiebot) while keeping page scrolling unlocked.
- **URL Tracking Parameter Stripping (Included Free):** Strips tracking parameters (`utm_`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `msclkid`) from clicked links at the network layer.
- **Element Zapper & Anti-Adblock Stealth:** One-click visual page element removal paired with MAIN-world anti-adblock bait protection.
- **Total Tab & RAM Tamer:** Automatically hibernates inactive background tabs to reduce browser memory usage while protecting pinned, audio, and active form tabs.

## Live Anti-Detection Benchmark (Test Lab)
SWEEPR Deepblock verifies browser protection across 8 live checks on the public Adblock & Anti-Detection Test Lab (https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab):
1. Network Ad Request Blocking (Google Ads `adsbygoogle.js`)
2. Cosmetic Bait Honeypot Protection (`adsbox` layout check)
3. Page Scroll Restoration after Cookie Banner Removal
4. YouTube & Video Player Ad Protection
5. Tracking Beacon & Analytics Blocking (GA4, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel)
6. URL Tracking Parameter Stripping (`utm_`, `fbclid`, `gclid`)
7. Third-Party Banner & Overlay Script Neutralization
8. Zero Browser Fingerprinting Script Exposure
